'''Saulis Pau''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. However, after suffering extensive injuries he was discharged from the [[Army/Legends|army]] and was fitted with extensive [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacement body parts. He later became a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], taking contracts exclusively on the behalf of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was available for contract in [[Feris City]] and on one occasion he performed an assignment for [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Heas]]. Pau was proficient in the use of a variety of different types of weapon and explosives.<ref name="BM" />
